headline: Guarding Media Type Logic in mediaType.go
what_breaks: deps/deps.go — relies on Type for media type handling
resources/resource/resourcetypes.go — depends on Type for resource type definitions
helpers/content.go — uses FromContent for content type resolution
why: This file contains the Type struct and the FromContent function, both of which are critical for media type identification and handling. Changes here could affect how media types are processed across multiple dependent files.
checklist: Review changes to Type struct and its fields
Ensure FromContent logic aligns with expected MIME type behavior
Check for impacts on dependent files like deps/deps.go and resources/resource/resourcetypes.go
